title: Natur Eis Palast Hintertuxer Gletscher
highlights: Weltweit einzigartige begehbare natuerliche Gletscherspalte tief im ewigen Eis
Gefrorene Wasserfaelle, funkelnde Eiskristalle und ein unterirdischer Gletschersee
Moeglichkeit zur gefuehrten Stand-Up-Paddle- und Bootstour auf dem Eissee
Ganzjaehrig konstante Innentemperatur von null Grad Celsius auf 3250 Metern
kurzbeschreibung: The Natur Eis Palast at the Hintertuxer Gletscher takes visitors deep inside a natural glacial crevasse featuring an ice lake and sparkling ice crystals.
beschreibung:
Inside the Belly of the Glacier

At an elevation of 3,250 meters on the Hintertuxer Gletscher lies a fascinating natural wonder: the Natur Eis Palast. Unlike artificially carved ice caves, this system of crevasses, chambers, and tunnels formed entirely naturally within the glacial ice.

Magical Ice World and Underground Lake

Guided tours reveal glittering ice halls adorned with gigantic stalactites and towering ice walls in deep shades of blue. A standout highlight is the emerald-green glacial lake, where adventurous visitors can glide across the frozen waters in boats or on stand-up paddleboards.
